sketches.mechanism: Ownership move semantics: passing a non-Copy value transfers ownership, and the compiler rejects any later use of the moved binding.
sketches.resonance: A heart once given cannot be offered again by the one who no longer has it.

sketches.mechanism: The temporal dead zone for let bindings: a name is in scope before initialization, but touching it throws a ReferenceError.
sketches.resonance: The future may already have a name, yet arriving early makes it unreachable.

sketches.mechanism: ARC weak references do not retain their object and are automatically set to nil when the last strong reference leaves scope.
sketches.resonance: What refuses to possess cannot keep the beloved from disappearing.
